propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables/retunes to be ignored and activated project DET criteria to disappear
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must be compiled from repository root and operation inputs before any selection or model call to serve as deterministic authority
Project code-review LLM criteria must declare applies_to as a non-empty list of globs, with ["**"] as the explicit spelling for repository-wide unconditional selection

The shared _validate_applies_to validator must permit empty lists for plan-review criteria (preserving ADR 0074 contract) while the stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code-review project criteria at snapshot compile time

Contract tests must verify snapshot-derived selection matches current behavior when no overlay is present, proves applies_to:["**"] selects unconditionally including on empty changed_files, and validates all acceptance criteria including built-in and DET inclusion
